summary: Frontend-only test of shareable family offer link feature (P2). Tested admin offer creation flow (/admin/teklifler), live pricing, WhatsApp share link format, public customer offer page (/teklif/:token), disable flow, unknown-token error, apply form pre-fill, and regressions on /basvuru & home. All 9 scenarios from the request passed.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOffers.jsx (535 lines) is nearing the 700-line threshold and mixes form state, live quote fetching, list logic, and OfferRow presentational component. Consider splitting: extract OfferForm, OfferList, useLiveQuote hook, and product/visa loaders for maintainability.

In AdminOffers.jsx `storeItems` useMemo hardcodes insurance quantity to rows.length (correct per business rule, comment present) but eSIM quantity is independent; there is no UI hint that changing traveler count won't affect eSIM. Minor UX polish only.

Offer.jsx: after clicking Kapat and then re-opening the same disabled link, the client relies on backend to return 4xx and shows offer-error. Consider adding a specific message differentiating 'Kapatıldı' vs 'Süresi doldu' vs 'Bulunamadı' via error code from backend for better UX.
